title: Seguir + Gerund: Still Going On
goal: Say that something is still going on, or still has not happened, with seguir.

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can say that something is still going on with seguir and a gerund, in the present and the past.
I can say that something still has not happened with seguir sin and an infinitive.
I can use the new words for contests and for not giving up.
